entities.summary: The Tupolev Tu-2000 was a planned hypersonic flight experimental aircraft designed by the Tupolev design bureau. It was intended to test technologies for a single-stage-to-orbit aerospace plane and also the Tupolev Tu-360 intercontinental bomber.
